title: 第475章 恶魔
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

解决完外面的事情，

杰克又赶忙从商铺内翻找了一些工具，带回后院。

此时的院落内，早已沦为一片血腥屠场。

猩红鲜血浸透整个院子，碎肉残渣四随处可见。

空气中弥漫着刺鼻浓郁的血腥味，简直令人作呕。

林奇浑身染血，身姿挺拔的站在院子中央。

他的面前则是一个血肉模糊，身形难辨，只剩一团残破人形的物体。

“解决了？”

林奇扭头瞥向杰克，语气平静得没有一丝波澜。

仿佛脚下惨烈的景象与他毫无关系。

杰克点了点头，将工具放到一旁。

仅仅用余光瞥了眼场中的状况，他便浑身紧绷、头皮发麻。

纵使他曾经被困在斗兽场，见惯生死、厮杀、血腥。

可眼前这般残忍的景象，依旧超过了杰克平生所见。

林奇抬手拿出一张治愈卡。

源力涌动，治愈的光芒笼罩住地上的那滩仅剩下人形的血肉。

濒临断气的罗根，在治愈之力的强行拉扯下。

破碎的皮肉快速愈合，消逝的生机被硬生生拽回体内。

生命停止流逝，罗根的意识回笼。

他艰难的张着嘴，嗓音嘶哑破碎。

“不……不要再打了……求你……放过我……”

林奇拿着辣椒水和钳子，走到罗根面前，居高临下的俯视他。

“别急。”

他嘴角噙笑，语气轻柔，声音比绅士还温柔。

“这才刚使用了第一张治愈卡，我这里可是准备了很多给你用呢。”

闻言，罗根瞳孔骤缩，恐惧、绝望蔓延到心头。

他混迹山林多年，打家劫舍、劫掠商队、囚禁路人，作恶无数。

自认见过太多残酷刑罚。

可他想破脑袋都想不到，世上竟有这般歹毒可怕的手段。

将人折磨至濒死，再用治愈卡复原生机，往复循环，反复折磨。

眼前之人，根本不是人。

他是从地狱爬出的，披着人皮的恶魔！

“不，不……”

“啊！！”

不等罗根说什么，林奇已经用钳子一个一个把他的指甲给拔掉。

钻心刺骨的剧痛瞬间炸开，罗根生生疼晕过去了两次。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After settling the external matters,

Jack hurriedly searched for some tools from the shop and brought them back to the backyard.

At this time, the courtyard had long been reduced to a bloody slaughterhouse.

Scarlet blood soaked the entire yard, and scraps of meat could be seen everywhere.

The pungent and rich smell of blood filled the air, which was simply nauseating.

Lin Qi was covered in blood and stood tall and straight in the middle of the yard.

In front of him was a bloody and indistinguishable figure, leaving only a broken human-shaped object.

"Solved?"

Lynch turned his head and glanced at Jack, his tone calm without a trace of ripples.

It was as if the tragic scene beneath his feet had nothing to do with him.

Jack nodded and put the tools aside.

Just glancing at the situation in the field with his peripheral vision, his whole body became tense and his scalp became numb.

Even though he was once trapped in the Colosseum and was used to seeing life and death, fighting and bloodshed.

But the cruel sight before him was still beyond what Jack had ever seen in his life.

Lynch raised his hand and took out a healing card.

The source of power surged, and the healing light enveloped the pool of human flesh and blood on the ground.

Logan, who was on the verge of dying, was forcibly pulled by the healing power.

The broken flesh healed quickly, and the lost vitality was forcefully pulled back into the body.

Life stopped flowing and Logan's consciousness returned.

He opened his mouth with difficulty, his voice hoarse and broken.

"No...don't fight anymore...please...let me go..."

Lynch took the chili pepper water and pliers, walked up to Logan, and looked down at him condescendingly.

"Don't worry."

There was a smile on his lips, his tone was gentle, and his voice was gentler than that of a gentleman.

"I just used the first healing card. I have prepared a lot for you to use."

Hearing this, Logan's pupils shrank suddenly, and fear and despair spread into his heart.

He has been wandering in the mountains and forests for many years, robbing homes, plundering caravans, imprisoning passers-by, and committed countless crimes.

I think I have seen too many cruel punishments.

But he couldn't even think of such vicious and terrifying methods in the world.

Torture people until they are close to death, then use the healing card to restore their original vitality, and the cycle goes back and forth, and the torture is repeated.

The person in front of me is not a human at all.

He crawled out from hell, a demon in human skin!

"No, no..."

"Ah!!"

Before Logan could say anything, Lynch had already used pliers to pull out his nails one by one.

The piercing pain exploded instantly, and Luo Gen fainted twice from the pain.
